en.summary: Anthropic released a research report on October 27 stating that an undisclosed internal Claude research model found vulnerabilities in Chrome, Safari, Android, Windows, and Linux and chained them into five working attack chains; the vulnerabilities were reported and fixed through coordinated disclosure.
